Once the item actually ships, you’ll receive a shipping confirmation email with the tracking number. If you haven’t received that email yet, it usually means the order is still being prepared or produced and hasn’t been handed to the carrier yet.
After the carrier receives the package, tracking updates can sometimes take a little time to appear while they perform the first scan.
If you’d like, you can also share your order number and I can guide you on what to expect next.
